# Kautusang Bayan Blg. 01, Series of 2015

**Isang Kapasiyahan na Nagtatakda ng Kautusang Bayan na Nagbabawal sa Sinuman na Magtayo ng Bahay na Tirahan sa Tabi ng Isang Log na Nasasakupan ng Bayan ng Pitogo, Quezon Upang Makaiwas sa Anomalyang Nagpapasama na mga Hayop at Iba pa na Nakaaapekto sa Kaligtasan ng Lahat Dito sa Kalsada**

_(Prohibiting Construction of Dwellings Near Roads and Regulating Sale of Animals Near Roads to Prevent Accidents)_

Kapasiyahan Blg. 091

## Summary

Prohibits the construction of residential dwellings near roads within the [[Municipality of Pitogo]] and regulates the sale of animals near roads to prevent accidents. The ordinance addresses public safety concerns arising from structures and animal-related activities along roads that pose hazards to motorists and pedestrians.

## Key Provisions

- **Prohibition on Construction:** Bars any person from constructing residential dwellings near roads within the municipality
- **Animal Sale Regulation:** Regulates the sale and display of animals near roads to prevent accidents
- **Public Safety:** Aims to protect the safety of all road users from hazards caused by roadside structures and animals
